metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the full moon, two pence of cloves, and a Roman part you kept.

yesterday: The sheet is still Monday's eleven lines. The moon was full.
The cloves were two pence. She saw Tuesday's three sockets and saved the speech.
You played the old Roman and died in the fourth. Cowley offered. You kept the gown. The Rose bill was Crack Me.
The tooth began on the ninth of September. Yesterday was four weeks of it.
Tomorrow term opens. The comedy is at two, and you are Navarre. The morning rehearsal is at nine. The king was yesterday. The next king is the sixteenth.
